reddit.title: Improving Audio Experience in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made significant improvements to the music in Provincia! Instead of abrupt transitions, our new long equal-power crossfade technique ensures a seamless audio experience as you build your colony. This means no more jarring cuts when day turns to night or during combat. Learn more about the updates and how they enhance gameplay here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
